content.comment_body: Good afternoon, how did you configure AWS? The 'AWSElasticBeanstalkfull' policy is no longer available. I tried but I get a message saying that connection to 'AWSElasticBeanstal' is not possible. Thank you.

Hello [user_name], Please consider posting your question in English, as this is an international forum focused on that language. Writing in English will help you receive more responses to your inquiry. Here is the translation of your question. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing issues connecting to AWS Elastic Beanstalk, mainly due to the removal or change of the 'AWSElasticBeanstalkfull' policy, which creates confusion and interrupts their workflow. Technical difficulties are reported, but the moderator only responds regarding language use rather than the technical problem.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants clear guidance or documentation on configuring AWS, uninterrupted access to AWS Elastic Beanstalk, and solutions for workflow problems caused by AWS policy or service changes.
